G1.def: of Hebrew origin; the first letter of the alphabet; figuratively, only (from its use as a numeral) the first: --Alpha. Often used (usually an, before a vowel) also in composition (as a contraction from «427») in the sense of privation; so, in many words, beginning with this letter; occasionally in the sense of union (as a contraction of «260»).

G2.def: of Hebrew origin («0175»); Aaron, the brother of Moses:--Aaron.

G3.def: of Hebrew origin («011»); a destroying angel:--Abaddon.

G4.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and «922»; weightless, i.e. (figuratively) not burdensome:--from being burdensome.

G5.def: of Chaldee origin («02»); father as a vocative:--Abba.

G6.def: of Hebrew origin («01893»); Abel, the son of Adam:--Abel.

G7.def: of Hebrew origin («029»); Abijah, the name of two Israelites:--Abia.

G8.def: of Hebrew origin («054»); Abiathar, an Israelite:--Abiathar.

G9.def: of foreign origin (compare «058»); Abilene, a region of Syria:--Abilene.

G10.def: of Hebrew origin («031»); Abihud, an Israelite:--Abiud.

G11.def: of Hebrew origin («085»); Abraham, the Hebrew patriarch:--Abraham. (In Acts 7:16 the text should probably read Jacob.)

G12.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and a variation of (1037)
G12.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and a variation of «1037»; depthless, i.e. (specially) (infernal) "abyss":--deep, (bottomless) pit.

G13.def: of Hebrew origin (compare «02285»); Agabus, an Israelite:--Agabus.

G14.def: from «18» and «2041»; to work good:--do good.

G15.def: from «17»; to be a well-doer (as a favor or a duty):--(when) do good (well).

G17.def: from «18» and «4160»; a well-doer, i.e. virtuous:--them that do well.

G18.def: a primary word; "good" (in any sense, often as noun):--benefit, good(-s, things), well. Compare «2570».

G19.def: from «18»; goodness, i.e. virtue or beneficence:--goodness.

G21.def: from agan (much) and «242»; properly, to jump for joy, i.e. exult:--be (exceeding) glad, with exceeding joy, rejoice (greatly).

G22.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and «1062»; unmarried:--unmarried.

G23.et: from agan (much) and achthos (grief, akin to the base of (43))
G23.def: from agan (much) and achthos (grief; akin to the base of «43»); to be greatly afflicted, i.e. (figuratively) indignant:--be much (sore) displeased, have (be moved with, with) indignation.

G25.def: perhaps from agan (much) (or compare «5689»); to love (in a social or moral sense):--(be-)love(-ed). Compare «5368».

G26.def: from «25»; love, i.e. affection or benevolence; specially (plural) a love-feast:--(feast of) charity(-ably), dear, love.

G28.def: of Hebrew origin («01904»); Hagar, the concubine of Abraham:--Hagar.

G29.def: of foreign origin (compare «0104»); properly, to be a courier, i.e. (by implication) to press into public service:--compel (to go).

G30.et: from aggos (a pail, perhaps as bent, cf base of (43))
G30.def: from aggos (a pail, perhaps as bent; compare the base of «43»); a receptacle:--vessel.

G31.def: from «32»; an announcement, i.e. (by implication) precept:--message.

G32.et: from aggello [probably derived from (71), cf (34)] (to bring tidings)
G32.def: from aggello (probably derived from «71»; compare «34») (to bring tidings); a messenger; especially an "angel"; by implication, a pastor:--angel, messenger.

G33.def: imperative of «71»; properly, lead, i.e. come on:--go to.

G35.def: from «1» (as negative particle) and «1075»; unregistered as to birth:--without descent.

G36.def: from «1» (as negative particle) and «1085»; properly, without kin, i.e. (of unknown descent, and by implication) ignoble:--base things.

G37.def: from «40»; to make holy, i.e. (ceremonially) purify or consecrate; (mentally) to venerate:--hallow, be holy, sanctify.

G38.def: from «37»; properly, purification, i.e. (the state) purity; concretely (by Hebraism) a purifier:--holiness, sanctification.

G39.def: neuter of «40»; a sacred thing (i.e. spot):--holiest (of all), holy place, sanctuary.

G40.def: from hagos (an awful thing) (compare «53», «2282»); sacred (physically, pure, morally blameless or religious, ceremonially, consecrated):--(most) holy (one, thing), saint.

G43.def: from agkos (a bend, "ache"); an arm (as curved):--arm.

G44.def: from the same as «43»; a hook (as bent):--hook.

G45.def: from the same as «43»; an "anchor" (as crooked):--anchor.

G46.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and the same as (1102)
G46.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and the same as «1102»; properly, unfulled, i.e. (by implication) new (cloth):--new.

G48.def: from «53»; to make clean, i.e. (figuratively) sanctify (ceremonially or morally):--purify (self).

G49.def: from «48»; a cleansing (the act), i.e. (ceremonially) lustration:--purification.

G50.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and «3539»; not to know (through lack of information or intelligence); by implication, to ignore (through disinclination):--(be) ignorant(-ly), not know, not understand, unknown.

G51.def: from «50»; a thing ignored, i.e. shortcoming:--error.

G53.def: from the same as «40»; properly, clean, i.e. (figuratively) innocent, modest, perfect:--chaste, clean, pure.

G56.def: from «1» (as negative particle) and «1108»; ignorance (properly, the state):--ignorance, not the knowledge.

G58.et: from ageiro (to gather, probably akin to (1453))
G58.def: from ageiro (to gather; probably akin to «1453»); properly, the town-square (as a place of public resort); by implication, a market or thoroughfare:--market(-place), street.

G59.def: from «58»; properly, to go to market, i.e. (by implication) to purchase; specially, to redeem:--buy, redeem.

G60.def: from «58»; relating to the market-place, i.e. forensic (times); by implication, vulgar:--baser sort, low.

G61.def: from «71»; (abstractly) a catching (of fish); also (concretely) a haul (of fish):--draught.

G62.def: from «1» (as negative particle) and «1121»; unlettered, i.e. illiterate:--unlearned.

G63.def: from «68» and «832» (in the sense of «833»); to camp out:--abide in the field.

G64.def: from «61»; to hunt, i.e. (figuratively) to entrap:--catch.

G65.def: from «66» and «1636»; an oleaster:--olive tree (which is) wild.

G66.def: from «68»; wild (as pertaining to the country), literally (natural) or figuratively (fierce):--wild, raging.

G67.def: apparently from «66» and «2462»; wild-horse tamer; Agrippas, one of the Herods:--Agrippa.

G68.def: from «71»; a field (as a drive for cattle); genitive case, the country; specially, a farm, i.e. hamlet:--country, farm, piece of ground, land.

G69.def: ultimately from «1» (as negative particle) and «5258»; to be sleepless, i.e. keep awake:--watch.

G70.def: from «69»; sleeplessness, i.e. a keeping awake:--watch.

G71.def: a primary verb; properly, to lead; by implication, to bring, drive, (reflexively) go, (specially) pass (time), or (figuratively) induce:--be, bring (forth), carry, (let) go, keep, lead away, be open.

G72.def: reduplicated from «71»; a bringing up, i.e. mode of living:--manner of life.

G73.def: from «71»; properly, a place of assembly (as if led), i.e. (by implication) a contest (held there); figuratively, an effort or anxiety:--conflict, contention, fight, race.

G74.def: from «73»; a struggle (properly, the state), i.e. (figuratively) anguish:--agony.

G75.def: from «73»; to struggle, literally (to compete for a prize), figuratively (to contend with an adversary), or genitive case (to endeavor to accomplish something):--fight, labor fervently, strive.

G76.def: of Hebrew origin («0121»); Adam, the first man; typically (of Jesus) man (as his representative):--Adam.

G77.def: from «1» (as negative particle); and «1160»; costless, i.e. gratuitous:--without expense.

G78.def: probably of Hebrew origin (compare «05716»); Addi, an Israelite:--Addi.

G79.def: fem of «80»; a sister (naturally or ecclesiastically):--sister.

G80.et: from (1) (as a connective particle) and delphus (the womb)
G80.def: from «1» (as a connective particle) and delphus (the womb); a brother (literally or figuratively) near or remote (much like «1»):--brother.

G81.def: from «80»; brotherhood (properly, the feeling of brotherliness), i.e. the (Christian) fraternity:--brethren, brotherhood.

G82.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and «1212»; hidden, figuratively, indistinct:--appear not, uncertain.

G85.et: from a derivative of adeo (to be sated to loathing)
G85.def: from a derivative of adeo (to be sated to loathing); to be in distress (of mind):--be full of heaviness, be very heavy.

G86.def: from «1» (as negative particle) and «1492»; properly, unseen, i.e. "Hades" or the place (state) of departed souls:--grave, hell.

G87.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of (1252)
G87.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and a derivative of «1252»; properly, undistinguished, i.e. (actively) impartial:--without partiality.

G88.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of a compound of (1223) and (3007)
G88.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and a derivative of a compound of «1223» and «3007»; unintermitted, i.e. permanent:--without ceasing, continual.

G89.def: adverb from «88»; uninterruptedly, i.e. without omission (on an appropriate occasion):--without ceasing.

G90.def: from a derivative of a compound of «1» (as a negative particle) and a derivative of «1311»; incorruptibleness, i.e. (figuratively) purity (of doctrine):--uncorruptness.

G91.def: from «94»; to be unjust, i.e. (actively) do wrong (morally, socially or physically):--hurt, injure, be an offender, be unjust, (do, suffer, take) wrong.

G92.def: from «91»; a wrong done:--evil doing, iniquity, matter of wrong.

G93.def: from «94»; (legal) injustice (properly, the quality, by implication, the act); morally, wrongfulness (of character, life or act):--iniquity, unjust, unrighteousness, wrong.

G94.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and «1349»; unjust; by extension wicked; by implication, treacherous; specially, heathen:--unjust, unrighteous.

G96.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and «1384»; unapproved, i.e. rejected; by implication, worthless (literally or morally):--castaway, rejected, reprobate.

G97.def: from «1» (as a negative particle}; and «1388»; undeceitful, i.e. (figuratively) unadulterated:--sincere.

G98.et: from Adramutteion (a place in Asia Minor)
G98.def: from Adramutteion (a place in Asia Minor); Adramyttene or belonging to Adramyttium:--of Adramyttium.

G99.et: from Adria (a place near its shore)
G99.def: from Adria (a place near its shore); the Adriatic sea (including the Ionian):--Adria.
